stable.notes: Miles Windu V15.3 ships the approved 25-frame four-plus-session sequence: a continuous clockwise spin into a reverse-grip strike on the lower-right droid, electrical breakup, wrist load, and visible saber release, flip, and catch. Force control and pull-to-strike, defensive blocks, and full droid dissolves remain intact. The one-, two-, and three-session stories are unchanged at 16, 17, and 13 frames. The swarm plays all 25 frames in 5.50 seconds at 100% speed. Exact stock V15.2 and earlier packs upgrade automatically; custom artwork and pose scales remain untouched. Preserves the ledger-bar pet interface, hover pills, per-session completion history, terminal jump, 25% to 200% character speed, and 3x stock idle from 0.5.142. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
